sources.title: City of Chicago, Energy Usage 2010 (Chicago Data Portal dataset 8yq3-m6wp)
sources.access: Download https://data.cityofchicago.org/resource/8yq3-m6wp.csv?$limit=100000&$order=:id with no login or key. It is the portal's SODA2 endpoint, so the header row uses the API field names. The dataset has not changed since 2013: rows were last updated 2013-08-02, and the endpoint's Last-Modified is Thu, 18 Apr 2019 08:32:28 GMT. Three downloads on 2026-11-23 (UTC) were byte-identical: 67,051 rows, 37,004,866 bytes, SHA-256 6e59d593ef8c0a21aea92fcea363bcbb1770fdad221e2f8d2ca199ee9391802b. fetch_raw.py downloads and checks it. The portal's /api/views/8yq3-m6wp/rows.csv export is not used, because it returns Sunset: Tue, 22 Dec 2026.
sources.citation: City of Chicago, Energy Usage 2010, Chicago Data Portal, dataset 8yq3-m6wp: https://data.cityofchicago.org/d/8yq3-m6wp. ComEd and Peoples Gas data, aggregated by Accenture.

recipes.name: energy_usage_2010
recipes.description: The City of Chicago's Energy Usage 2010, every column typed: one row per community area, census block, building type and subtype, plus one row per community area that the portal gives without a census block.

steps.name: type_and_check
steps.description: Check that the CSV is the pinned download (its SHA-256) with the portal's 73 columns in order. Give every column a fixed type: census blocks as their 15-digit code; energy, counts, floor areas, minimums and maximums as integers; means, standard deviations, quartiles and averages as decimals. Split the two account counts into a number and a note ("Less than 4"), rename the portal's misspelled term_april_2010, sort by the key, and check the table's known facts.

recipes.name: community_areas
recipes.description: Electricity (kWh) and gas (therms) used in 2010 in each of Chicago's 77 community areas, summed over the census-block rows of Energy Usage 2010.

steps.name: sum_block_rows
steps.description: Sum annual kWh and therms over each community area's census-block rows, leaving out the portal's rows without a census block (see the README), count the blocks and rows behind each sum, and check that nothing is lost.

recipes.name: monthly
recipes.description: Monthly electricity (kWh) and gas (therms) for every row of Energy Usage 2010, in long form: one row per community area, census block, building type, subtype and month of 2010.

steps.name: to_long
steps.description: Turn the twelve kWh and twelve therm columns into one row per month, keeping the key, and check that every row's months add up to its published annual totals.
